title: An Interpretable Approach to Hateful Meme Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting named entities related to racial and ethnic groups (e.g., 'asians', 'mexicans') and measuring their feature importance in a gradient-boosted decision tree model designed to detect hateful memes.
Identifying named entities related to religious groups (e.g., 'jews', 'muslims', 'islamic') and evaluating their predictive value and feature importance for multimodal hate speech classification.
Flagging dogwhistle hate words (e.g., 'dishwasher' used in a derogatory manner to refer to women) using frequency searches and internet corpuses to classify gender-targeted hateful memes.
